mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is continuously predictive without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05, or average 20-day returns in lowest FEDFUNDS quartile are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals economic deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a multiplicative positive effect on equity valuations, where RSAFS growth is amplified when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (RSAFS * FEDFUNDS) has p-value > 0.05 in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary policy easing cycles (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5pp over 6 months) reduce discount rates and improve risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) consistently signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS growth is above 50th percentile, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 thousand units signal strong residential construction and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust economic activity, where INDPRO growth is amplified when RSAFS is high, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (INDPRO * RSAFS) has p-value > 0.05 in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized) signals reduced corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
